name: led_rgb_5050
title: An RGB LED in a 5050 package, with no driver
notes: Three LEDs in one package, each on a pin of its own. It is here for its price by the piece: what an RGB LED of a board that nobody asked for weighs.

lcsc.source: C2874125, NationStar NH-5050RGBA-SH: search results of lcsc.com gave 0.024 to 0.047 for 10 to 4500 pieces; the high end is taken for the least quantity and the low for the largest, as the tiers of LCSC go down.
